# SciFin

SciFin is a Software Development company. SciFin brings together revenue context spread across people and systems to keep it current. Your teams see risk sooner, act decisively, and win more and bigger deals faster, with fewer tools to manage. SciFin employs 57 people. Headquartered in San Jose, California, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States and India.

## About

Better customer outcomes start with GTM teams seeing the same picture. But the signals behind that picture are often scattered across people, systems, and AI agents, creating the Context Gap.

SciFin’s Context Convergence brings those signals together into a shared understanding, and puts it to work, giving your GTM team the confidence to execute flawlessly.
